title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 00:47:17 最新章节：第271章 三十年
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
伏龙山山顶，竹屋内。
一口黑漆棺材摆在空地上，十几个穿着麻衣的汉子围成一圈，个个面面相觑，一脸懵逼。
“老爷子，这不太好吧？私自埋活人在楚国是犯法的。”领头的壮汉咽了口唾沫，偷偷瞄了一眼抚摸着棺材嘿嘿傻笑的老头。
这老头是个神经病！
哪有出钱埋自己的。
“犯什么法？犯什么法？你不说我不说谁知道啊？法律难道没有告诉你，不能违背老人意愿吗！”
陶潜抚摸着这一口漆黑棺材，像是看什么稀世珍宝一般，听到那壮汉的话，顿时气急败坏。
“我不管，今天你们不把我埋了，我就把你们拉去县廷，告你们殴打老人！你们知道我今年多少岁了吗？100岁！100岁的老头！我就算是把你们县廷的县尹打了他都得说我打得响！”
“这……”
几个汉子对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了荒唐。他们本以为是哪家老人过世，上山来送葬挣点辛苦钱。谁知道这老头活蹦乱跳的，却要埋自己？
关键是他们还不好得罪对方，一百岁的老人在楚国一般认为是天降的祥瑞，这老头甚至能当国宝供着了。
“这是五百蚁鼻钱，完事之后，在我坟前哭七七四十九天，一定要哭的撕心裂肺，事成之后，我再给你们两千蚁鼻钱。”
蚁鼻钱，这是楚国的货币，不过所用的人不多，大多都是采取以物换物的模式，普通百姓想要攒一些钱，非常不容易，普通情况基本上见不到，只有从那些富商手上才能流出一些。
那壮汉人都看呆了，摸着手上一大袋铜币。
五百蚁鼻钱，他这辈子都没见过这么多钱。至于这个老人后面说的两千蚁鼻钱，那就算了。据他观察，这个老人没有亲人，那两千估计就是打水漂了。不过五百蚁鼻钱，那也是一个巨款。
“大哥，要不我们干了吧？这些钱够我们家里养活一个多月了。”旁边的小弟咽了一口唾沫。
“好，我们干了！”
那壮汉一咬牙，想着反正是荒山野岭，也没有人注意到。
“老杖，这可是你要求我们埋的，出了事你可不能扯我们身上。”
那壮汉自我安慰了一句。

“不扯不扯。”
陶潜连连摆手，转身走向棺材，动作利落地躺进去。
棺材内部比寻常的要深一些，陶潜的手在底部摸索片刻，突然用力一按。
咔哒一声轻响。
棺材底部竟然弹开一块木板，露出下方的夹层。陶潜身子一缩，钻进了那狭窄的空间里，然后将桃木拐杖放在上层。
“盖棺，封棺。”他的声音从棺材里传出来，闷闷的。
几个汉子你看我，我看看你，最终还是照做了。棺材盖合上，最后拿出钉子封棺。
夹层里一片漆黑。
陶潜闭上眼睛，心中默默计算着时辰。
这是尸解之法中的“杖解”，以桃木杖代替肉身，欺骗地府鬼差。
等鬼差来勾魂时，看到的只会是那根拐杖化成的“尸体”，找不到他的魂魄，等误了勾魂的时辰，又见尸身腐烂，便会将他当做孤魂野鬼处理，从生死簿上划去名字。
如此，便算是成仙了。
这算是一个取巧的办法。万物生灵的寿命都在生死簿上。
content_en:
On the top of Fulong Mountain, inside the bamboo house.
A black coffin was placed in the open space, and a dozen men in linen clothes gathered in a circle, all looking at each other in confusion.
"Old man, is this not good? It is illegal in Chu State to bury a living person privately." The strong man in the lead swallowed and glanced at the old man who was stroking the coffin and giggling.
This old man is a psycho!
How can anyone pay to bury themselves?
"What kind of law is being broken? What kind of law is being broken? Who knows if you don't tell me or if I don't tell you? Doesn't the law tell you that you can't go against the wishes of an old man!"
Tao Qian stroked the dark coffin as if looking at a rare treasure. When he heard the strong man's words, he became furious.
"I don't care. If you don't bury me today, I will take you to the county court and accuse you of beating an old man! Do you know how old I am? 100 years old! A 100-year-old old man! Even if I beat the county magistrate of your county court, he will say that I beat him loudly!"
"This..."
Several men looked at each other and saw the absurdity in each other's eyes. They thought an old man from some family had passed away, and they came to the mountain to pay their respects to the deceased to earn some hard-earned money. Who knew that this old man was still alive and kicking, but he wanted to bury himself?
The key is that they don't want to offend each other. In Chu State, a hundred-year-old man is generally regarded as a blessing from heaven. This old man can even be regarded as a national treasure.
"This is five hundred ant's nose money. After you are done, you must cry in front of my grave for seven or forty-nine days. You must cry your heart out. After the thing is done, I will give you another two thousand ant's nose money."
Ant nose money is the currency of the Chu State, but not many people use it. Most of them adopt the barter-for-thing model. It is not easy for ordinary people to save some money. It is basically invisible under ordinary circumstances. Some money can only flow out from the hands of wealthy businessmen.
The strong man was stunned and touched a large bag of copper coins in his hand.
Five hundred ant nose money, he had never seen so much money in his life. As for the two thousand ant nose money the old man mentioned later, forget it. According to his observation, the old man had no relatives, so the two thousand dollars were probably wasted. But five hundred ant nose money is still a huge amount of money.
"Brother, why don't we do it? This money is enough to support our family for more than a month." The younger brother next to him swallowed.
"Okay, we're done!"
The strong man gritted his teeth, thinking that since it was a barren mountain, no one would notice.
"Laozhang, you asked us to bury this. If something happens, you can't drag it on us."
The strong man consoled himself.
"No bullshit, no bullshit."
Tao Qian waved his hands repeatedly, turned towards the coffin, and lay down in it neatly.
The inside of the coffin was deeper than usual. Tao Qian's hand fumbled around the bottom for a moment, then suddenly pressed hard.
There was a soft click.
A wooden board popped open at the bottom of the coffin, revealing the mezzanine underneath. Tao Qian shrank, got into the narrow space, and placed the mahogany crutch on the upper floor.
"Cover the coffin, seal the coffin." His voice came out from the coffin, muffled.
Several men looked at me and I looked at you, but finally they did as they were told. The coffin lid was closed, and finally nails were taken out to seal the coffin.
It was pitch black in the mezzanine.
Tao Qian closed his eyes and counted the hours silently in his heart.
This is the "stick solution" in the method of corpse removal. A peach wood stick is used to replace the physical body to deceive ghosts from the underworld.
When the ghost comes to seduce the soul, all he will see is the "corpse" turned into the crutch, and his soul cannot be found. If the time to seduce the soul is too late and the corpse is rotting, he will be treated as a lonely ghost and his name will be crossed out from the book of life and death.
In this way, one can become an immortal.
This is a trick. The lifespan of all living things is written in the book of life and death.
